text: In ZFC the ordered pair (a, b) is standardly encoded as the set {{a}, {a, b}}, an encoding known as the ___ ordered pair.
explanation: The Kuratowski encoding (a, b) = {{a}, {a, b}} lets ordered pairs — and hence relations, functions, and Cartesian products — be defined purely from sets, and it correctly satisfies (a, b) = (c, d) iff a = c and b = d.
